description: nilearn-tool 统筹已登记的独立方法和可复用流程。支持：混杂回归与去趋势；BOLD 平滑与时间滤波（保持原空间）；ROI 时间序列与功能连接；任务态一级 GLM；组水平 GLM；静息态 ICA；静息态 DICTLEARNING；kmeans 空间分区；其他方法可在详情中分页查询。

method_refs.label: 混杂回归与去趋势
method_refs.role: Reference Nilearn snippet for confound regression and detrending。 Inputs: bold: 预处理 BOLD 影像 (file); confounds: 混杂变量表 (file); mask: 脑掩膜 (file). Registered outputs: results/cleaned_bold.nii.gz.

method_refs.label: BOLD 平滑与时间滤波（保持原空间）
method_refs.role: Drop the requested initial BOLD volumes, apply the original spatial smoothing and temporal band-pass filtering, and save the processed series. Geometry stays in the input space; this entry does not estimate registration or motion correction. Inputs: bold: 预处理 BOLD 影像 (file). Registered outputs: results/preprocessed_bold.nii.gz.

method_refs.label: ROI 时间序列与功能连接
method_refs.role: Extract standardized, detrended ROI time series with Nilearn NiftiLabelsMasker and calculate a correlation connectivity matrix with ConnectivityMeasure; export ROI time series and NPY/CSV matrices。 Inputs: bold: 预处理 BOLD 影像 (file); atlas: 分区图谱 (file); labels: 图谱标签 (file). Registered outputs: results/connectome.npy, results/roi_timeseries.csv.

method_refs.label: 任务态一级 GLM
method_refs.role: Reference Nilearn snippet for first-level task GLM。 Inputs: bold: 预处理 BOLD 影像 (file); events: 事件表 (file); confounds: 混杂变量 (file); mask: 脑掩膜 (file). Registered outputs: results/z_map.nii.gz, results/effect_map.nii.gz.

method_refs.label: 组水平 GLM
method_refs.role: Reference Nilearn snippet for second-level GLM。 Inputs: contrast_maps: 对比影像路径清单 (file); design_matrix: 组设计矩阵 (file); mask: 脑掩膜 (file). Registered outputs: results/second_level_z_map.nii.gz.

method_refs.label: 静息态 ICA
method_refs.role: Reference Nilearn snippet for resting-state ICA。 Inputs: input_list: 影像路径清单 (file); mask: 脑掩膜 (file). Registered outputs: results/components.nii.gz.

method_refs.label: 静息态 DICTLEARNING
method_refs.role: Reference Nilearn snippet for resting-state DictLearning。 Inputs: input_list: 影像路径清单 (file); mask: 脑掩膜 (file). Registered outputs: results/components.nii.gz.

method_refs.label: kmeans 空间分区
method_refs.role: Create data-driven spatial clusters using the existing kmeans reference implementation on a list of aligned images and a common mask. The requested cluster count controls a learned label map. Cluster IDs have no predefined anatomical atlas meaning and are not a drop-in substitute for a FreeSurfer anatomical parcellation. Use only when this data-driven region definition matches the study; validate alignment, reproducibility and region interpretation before connectivity analysis.

method_refs.label: hierarchical 空间分区
method_refs.role: Create data-driven spatial clusters using the existing hierarchical reference implementation on a list of aligned images and a common mask. The requested cluster count controls a learned label map. Cluster IDs have no predefined anatomical atlas meaning and are not a drop-in substitute for a FreeSurfer anatomical parcellation. Use only when this data-driven region definition matches the study; validate alignment, reproducibility and region interpretation before connectivity analysis.

method_refs.label: SVM 分类与交叉验证
method_refs.role: Reference Nilearn/scikit-learn snippet for SVM disease classification。 Inputs: features: 特征表 (file); labels: 标签表 (file). Registered outputs: results/metrics.csv, results/predictions.csv.

method_refs.label: SpaceNet 空间正则分类
method_refs.role: Reference Nilearn snippet for SpaceNet disease classification。 Inputs: input_list: 影像路径清单 (file); labels: 标签表 (file); mask: 脑掩膜 (file). Registered outputs: results/coef_map.nii.gz.

selection_rules: 混杂回归、时间滤波、ROI 功能连接和任务 GLM 分别选择对应入口；它们不自动组成原始 BOLD 的完整预处理。
name: nilearn-tool
limitations: k-means 或层次聚类产生的数据驱动分区不等于解剖图谱；当前图像平滑和滤波入口也不估计配准或运动校正。
